author: Claude Code (sole code writer)
nature: Descriptive non-regression on previously inspected validation PUMP-08/09; not blind or independent evidence. Exactly the frozen train-selected Z995 and causal B1. No runner-up, no tuning, nothing fitted. Failure is preserved; no alternative candidate is tried.
exposure: Validation was inspected in earlier work (causal B1 per-event analysis, stored validation_summary.json). Phase 1 read no validation telemetry, features, snapshots, raw data, events or benign rows; fixtures are synthetic.

train_selection_evidence.requirement: Z995 gate_pass and correctness_pass true and selected == Z995 (re-read before any validation read)

data_scope.loading: assets.csv filtered to the two IDs with split validation (asserted); features/snapshots parquet via ID predicates (asserted); raw telemetry only from telemetry/asset_id=<ID>/ via read_asset_partition for assets with the required installed channels (capability recorded otherwise); events_validation.csv asserted to contain only the allowlist; benign filtered to the two IDs

scoring.scorer: official retrofit_sim.scoring.score with split='validation' (run_regime_reference.evaluate is NOT used: it hardcodes split='train')
scoring.wrong_specific_first: selective_diagnosis specific claims - correct specific claims (first diagnoses; UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS not specific)
scoring.wrong_channel_claims: non-gateway sensor events detected with predicted class SENSOR and a claimed channel different from the tag

adoption_gate.preserve: every B1-correct type event and every B1-correct sensor type+channel event
adoption_gate.correctness: control equality/metrics/composite, emission equality, 0 causality failures, 0 raw aggregation failures, fresh seed-0 hashes equal

correctness: full-evidence prefix + future mutation (means, std/min/max, counts=0, snapshots, future residual statistics) at the Task010 cut set for B1 and Z995; None/NaN-normalised comparison of every column

raw-aggregation prefix/future-mutation checks at reference end -1/0/+1 s, first post-reference alert boundary and a sub-minute cut per raw asset; future mutation on a COPY with operating_mode cast to object (Task013 categorical defect avoided)
fresh PYTHONHASHSEED=0 process reproduces the main prediction hashes
outputs: run_summary.json (adoption gate, lost events, changed events)

refusals_before_any_read: frozen Task013 evidence no longer shows Z995 passing/selected
runner.attempts: new results/validation_z995/run-<UTC>/ per attempt; partial attempts preserved

provenance_keys: validation_projection_hashes renames the Task010 helper keys to *_validation_* and adds split, allowlist, test_touched=false (sealed helper unchanged)
official_reports: report_B1.json and report_Z995.json saved in full; correctness requires split=='validation', assets==['PUMP-08','PUMP-09'], asset_days==14.0 for both
review: docs/tasks/014-review-round1.md addressed: validation key names; refuse before validation reads if train evidence fails; full official reports saved and their split/assets/exposure verified
